MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 24.5
   C. 49
   D. 7

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 3
   C. 21
   D. 17

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

4. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

5. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

6. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

7. Solve for x: x + 8 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 8
   C. 9
   D. 16

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15.6

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 19
   C. 30
   D. 60

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 36

11. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 18

12. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

13. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

14. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 15

16. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 36
   C. 13
   D. 5

17. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 20

18. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

19. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

20. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

21. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

22. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 169

23. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 28
   C. 29
   D. 3

24. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

25. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 4
   D. 33

26. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

27. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

28. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

29. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

30. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 5
